XR keynote speaker

The XR keynote speaker who builds what he talks about.

Morten Haulik gives keynotes on virtual reality, mixed reality, smart glasses and spatial computing for conferences, corporate events, universities and the public sector across Europe. Every talk draws on more than a decade of building XR that is used in hospitals, classrooms, campaigns and living rooms.

Why organisers book Morten

Most XR talks are either sales pitches or science fiction. Morten’s are neither. As the founder of NXT/WebXR, NXT/Care and MidwifeVR, he speaks from the engine room: what it actually takes to get immersive technology into people’s hands, and what happens when it gets there.

He has presented to members of the European Parliament and Commission and to UN delegations, spoken to audiences of more than 2,000 people and facilitated over 100 industry workshops.

  • A practitioner, not a futurist: every point is backed by products he has shipped
  • Clear for non-technical audiences, credible for experts
  • Real cases from healthcare, education, culture and brands
  • In English or Danish, on stage or online

Keynote topics

  1. 1

    The Spatial Internet

    Why the next big platform will be visited, not installed, and what that means for every brand, museum and publisher with a website.

  2. 2

    XR That Heals

    From maternity wards to children’s blood tests: what happens when immersive tech leaves the demo room and enters real hospitals.

  3. 3

    Glasses On: Hype vs. Reality

    Meta, Apple and Google are betting billions on your face. A builder’s honest guide to what is actually ready, and what isn’t.

  4. 4

    Campaigns People Step Into

    How brands use VR, AR and WebXR to create campaigns people remember, and why the best ones open from a single link.

Formats

Keynotes from 20 to 60 minutes, panel debates and moderated conversations, and hands-on workshops where participants try headsets themselves. Talks are tailored to your audience, whether that is healthcare, education, marketing, culture, tech or the public sector.

Stages and media

IDA Driving Health Tech, the Future Sound Forum by Danish Sound Cluster alongside Bang & Olufsen, the European Parliament and Eli Lilly’s NewGen event at Medical Museion. Media appearances include Berlingske, Radio4, DR2, Voice of America and The Copenhagen Post.

Frequently asked

What does Morten Haulik speak about?

Virtual reality, augmented and mixed reality, smart glasses, WebXR and the spatial internet, XR in healthcare and education, and immersive marketing. Every talk is grounded in products he has built.

Does Morten give keynotes in Danish?

Yes. Morten speaks in both Danish and English.

Can a keynote include a hands-on VR session?

Yes. A keynote can be paired with a workshop where participants try headsets and experiences themselves. Morten has facilitated more than 100 such workshops.

How do I book Morten as a keynote speaker?

Use the booking form on this page with your dates and audience size, or email Morten@nxtwebxr.com. He is based in Copenhagen and speaks across Denmark, Scandinavia and Europe.
